headline: Safaricom Names Boniface Mungania as Chief Financial Services Officer
summary: Safaricom PLC appointed Boniface Mungania as its Chief Financial Services Officer effective November 1, 2026, following regulatory approval.
why: Safaricom is Kenya's dominant telecommunications operator and provider of the M-Pesa mobile financial platform across East Africa.

impacts.name: Safaricom PLC
impacts.why: Executive appointment fills a key corporate leadership position overseeing financial services.
